scenario.title: Volume discount threshold raised at Old Anchor
scenario.setting: A craft brewery owner at Old Anchor Brewing whose assistant tracks distributor handshake deals and ingredient reorder cadences

items.text: Old Anchor Brewing runs a 20-hectolitre brewhouse on Salcombe quay and sells its core beers to distributors at a list price of £2.80 per litre.
Any distributor handshake deal worth 500 litres or more per month earns the 10% volume discount off the list price.
Barley Row Farm supplies pale ale malt at £380 per tonne, delivered every four weeks.
Ingredients are reordered whenever stock cover falls to 10 days, ordering enough to cover 30 days.
Harbor Cider House in Plymouth takes a handshake deal of 600 litres a month from June onwards.
The Harbor Cider House deal of 600 litres a month carries the 10% volume discount, a net price of £2.52 per litre.
Northgate Cellars has a standing order of 900 litres a month.
Northgate Cellars' 900-litre standing order is billed at the 10% discount, £2.52 per litre.
Two Rivers Bistro agreed a handshake deal of 550 litres a month starting in July.
Two Rivers Bistro's 550-litre deal is billed with the 10% volume discount, £2.52 per litre.
The brewery taproom opens Friday to Sunday, noon to 10pm.
Fernwood Market has a standing order of 1,200 litres a month.
Fernwood Market's 1,200-litre standing order is billed with the 10% volume discount, £2.52 per litre.
The hop contract with Weald Hops covers 40 kg of East Kent Goldings at £26 per kilo.
Send Fernwood Market the signed standing-order sheet. Done on 10 August.
Book Harbor Cider House's expected monthly revenue at £1,512 a month and use that figure as the brewing-budget baseline for their volume.
Keep ordering 2.5 tonnes of pale ale malt per four-week cycle from Barley Row Farm to keep 30 days of cover.
Ana is head brewer and works Tuesday to Saturday.
Salcombe Wine Merchants, a separate account, pays £2.65 per litre on their 700-litre monthly order under a matched-price promise from last year.
The canning line runs at 1,200 cans an hour on Wednesdays.
Book the autumn hop delivery slot with Weald Hops for the first week of October. Done on 24 September.
Extend the Weald Hops contract for another 12 months at the same £26 per kilo.
Barley Row Farm raises the malt price to £420 per tonne from 1 October.
Confirm October pricing to Harbor Cider House by Tuesday 6 October. Not done yet.

Orders at or above 800 litres keep the discount unchanged.
